column1: # ELF e_flags for RISC-V — DERIVED, do not edit.
# Produced by tools/gen-relocations.py: assemble an empty function at
# each march and read what the assembler puts in the header.
# `ld` refuses to merge objects whose float ABI disagrees. Ours said
# 0x0 — soft float — so no object we emitted could link against
# anything GNU built, and nothing noticed until one was offered to it.
